and [[The Last Day Dawns (Hard mode)]] }} Find and destroy the [[Titan]]s' source of power to save [[Tyria]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Travel to [[Grendich Courthouse]] and speak with [[Warmaster Labofski]] to learn how you can help defend against the Titan threat. * Travel to the northwest region of [[Dragon's Gullet]] and kill the 3 Titan bosses. * Return to [[Vision of Glint]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *75,000 [[Experience]] *10,000 [[Gold]] *1 [[Gold Zaishen Coin]] ==Walkthrough== The best strategy is to start out at Grendich Courthouse and travel to [[Flame Temple Corridor]], killing any bosses encountered along the way for extra [[morale]]. Alternatively, it is possible to start from [[Yak's Bend]] to have a party of 6 members, but this requires to make your way through [[Traveler's Vale]], [[Ascalon Foothills]] and [[Diessa Lowlands]]. In Flame Temple, you will encounter the Charr Lords. [[Pull]] them away from the [[patrol]]s and take them on one group at a time, then continue on to the [[Dragon's Gullet]]. Consider maxing out your morale before venturing into the lake itself. Enter the lake from the southeastern shore, northwest of the [[resurrection shrine]] that makes for a convenient restart spot should you [[wipe]] while fighting the Titan Lords. A pair of [[Hand of the Titans|Hand]] and [[Fist of the Titans|Fist]] of the Titans will [[popup|pop out of the tar]] to greet you. In the lake, you will have to deal with the constant 30% reduction in speed from the [[Tar]] [[environment effect]]. After you deal with the popups, you need to take out a number of titan patrols that circle the bosses. The patrols are made up of more Hands and Fists, and also [[Spark of the Titans|Sparks of the Titans]] and [[Risen Ashen Hulk]]s; the sparks should be your priority target as they are capable of some extremely lethal [[Fire Magic]]. The Risen Hulks are the least dangerous, and should be left for last as they split into another pair of Hand and Fist when they die. A second group of pop-up warrior titans will greet you in the southwest corner of the lake. After the lake has been cleared of patrols, it is time to complete the main objective. In the center of the lake are three Titan bosses: the Titan Lords you were sent here to dispatch. Among their ranks is a small group of Charr Lords. A good tactic is to kill the Charr Lords first then go for the Titans. ===Skill recommendations=== *A solid [[tank]] who can rush in and keep the bosses focused on him is an excellent complement to an [[Elementalist]] with [[Maelstrom]] who can render the [[Mesmer]] and [[Necromancer]] bosses useless for about 30 seconds (10 seconds of [[interrupt]]ions plus more time as their skills recharge). *Titans are very resistant to [[physical damage]], but less so to [[elemental damage]] - especially [[cold damage]]. **This can be easily accomplished with [[Icy]] weapon mods. **Alternatively, [[Winter]] will convert all elemental damage to cold damage. Because many mobs in the area use [[Greater Conflagration]], physical damage will also often be converted to cold damage through Winter. *An [[interrupt]] Mesmer can help here by shutting down the Necromancer boss and prevent him from casting [[Malaise]]. *A good way to break the anti-caster combination is to kill the Mesmer boss before the others. ===Tips=== *Due to the short distance, it's advised to leave from [[Yak's Bend]] for two additional party members. Be sure to first talk to Labofski though. *[[Rebel Yell]] helps in fighting the Charr during the quest. *Bringing [[Winter]] or other forms of [[cold damage]] is advised as the Titans have lower [[armor rating]] vs cold damage; however, [[armor-ignoring damage]], such as dealt by [[binding ritual]] [[spirit]]s and chaos damage, works too. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Charr]] *{{w}}{{e}} 30 [[Charr Axe Fiend]] *{{w}} 30 [[Charr Skullcrusher]] *{{r}} 30 [[Charr Hunter]] *{{mo}}{{w}} 30 [[Charr Shaman]] *{{me}}{{e}} 30 [[Charr Chaot]] *{{e}}{{me}} 30 [[Charr Flame Wielder]] *{{rt}}{{n}} 30 [[Charr Avenger]] *{{rt}}{{a}} 30 [[Charr Shadow]] [[Titan]]s (arranged in [[Titan#Spawning patterns|spawning pattern]] order) *{{n}} 32 [[Risen Ashen Hulk]] **{{w}}{{rt}} 26, 30, 32, 38, 40 [[Arm of the Titans]] **{{w}}{{a}} 26, 30, 32, 38, 40 [[Fist of the Titans]] *{{e}}{{me}} 38 [[Spark of the Titans]] ====Bosses==== Charr *{{w}}{{a}} 38 [[Phlog the Indomitable]] → [[Eviscerate]] *{{r}} 38 [[Staggh the Fervid]] → [[Greater Conflagration]] *{{n}} 38 [[Lugg the Malignant]] → [[Life Transfer]] *{{me}} 38 [[Druul the Untamed]] → [[Energy Drain]] *{{e}} 38 [[Singe the Malevolent]] → [[Savannah Heat]] Titans *{{r}}{{mo}} 40 [[Gigas Expii]] → [[Melandru's Resilience]] *{{n}} 40 [[Ludo Ossidi]] → [[Wither]] *{{me}} 40 [[Mallus Funo]] → [[Panic]] ==Dialogue== :''See [[The Titan Source#Dialogue]].''
